name: Shemariah
overview: The name Shemariah appears in Scripture associated with distinct individuals who served God's purposes in different contexts. One Shemariah is listed among David's mighty men, highlighting a role of loyal strength and service in Israel's early monarchy. Additionally, two Israelites named Shemariah are noted in Ezra as men who put away their Gentile wives, demonstrating a commitment to covenant faithfulness and separation from foreign influences as the people sought to restore purity in worship and community life after the exile.
